title: Long run 2h45 / ~1050m D+, 2 race-effort climbs
terrain: Framura coastal trails, ~1050m D+, two climbs of 15min+ and their descents

steps.target: Z2-Z3, 140-160bpm, descent at race effort, 172+ spm

coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 2h45, ~1050m D+. 15min easy, 1h40 at 145-155bpm (hike over 15%), then 2x(15min climb at 160-168bpm + 10min descent at race effort, 172+ spm).
GYM: none.
FUEL: 2 flasks Tailwind (500ml, 2 scoops) from min 20, Carbo Gels at 1h15 and 2h00 (~75g/h). Same breakfast and kit as race day.
GARMIN: ~250-290.
STOP RULE: HRV under 55 or RHR 52+ = 1 race-effort block, cap 2h15. Knee signal on descents or wet stone: walk them.
WHY: Sat long run moved here after 3 short nights; fresh legs, same race-effort stimulus (+10 vs old 175). Back-to-back comes in Wk7 (Sat 31 / Sun 1).
